before: The checkpoint manifest (version 3) held the media, the persons by revision w:id, and the takeovers with their suggestions. A suggestion of several Word changes came back as several, who typed inside another person's insertion was lost, a record Word writes no change record for (a control's value, a column's lent width) lost the value a reject gives back, and a load read a field's face from its begin run.
after: The checkpoint manifest (version 4) lists every pending suggestion once with every w:id its marks are written under (suggestions), the person of each room comment (comments), the takeovers by suggestion index, who typed the units of the insertions as runs over every unit the file writes (typers), the person of each namespace that typed (namespaces) and every record of properties an untracked record changes (untracked), keyed by Word ids, parts, element names and occurrences. A load makes the listed suggestions first, in the room's order. orderedUnitTyper reads a unit's typer and its person the same live and after a fold, also inside a new row, note or text box, and a room opened on a checkpoint knows the owner of those namespaces. The organiser's direct typing in a pending new note or text box is part of it, as in a new row. A version 3 manifest is refused (checkpoint-version). A prompt that content filled keeps the records on it at the first fill in its glossary block, as the engine keeps it, and a checkpoint lists their suggestions. Two suggestions of one w:id (two authors in a file) keep their own revision marks; exported Word files do not change otherwise. A field with no value (a file's own suggestion's person) is left out, a file's own values read as the load keeps them, and a manifest reads up to the engine's limit of one part (64 MiB), which the writer checks too.
reason: The Yjs document format and the ordered protocol do not change. Only the checkpoint manifest and the order of the suggestions a checkpoint's load makes do, and every copy of a room opens the same checkpoint with the same code version, so old and new copies never read each other's manifests. Ordered rooms are not deployed yet, so no checkpoint holds version 3 and no migration is needed.
